name: gaffer_render
description: Run a task node (Render, ImageWriter, SceneWriter, SystemCommand...) and its upstream tasks for frames in a separate background gaffer python, dispatched there by a LocalDispatcher: the open Gaffer stays usable and its file keeps its name. It reads a working copy of the open script (default) or the file as saved. The node writes its own outputs, or the EXACT output you name (shots/shot_####.png gives shot_0001.png...; a Render node needs exactly one file output for that), with size [w, h] for a Render node, for this run only. Returns a task: call again with task (and wait_s) for progress, or cancel. Relative paths are next to the .gfr.

node.description: A task node path, e.g. Render or Box.ImageWriter.

output.description: The exact output path; several frames need a # run or ${frame}.

frames.description: A frame, [start, end] or [start, end, step], whole frames (default: the script's current frame).

task.description: A task from an earlier call: its progress.

wait_s.description: With task: wait up to this long for it to finish (0 to 3600).
